name: saas-o-matic
description: Simulador y presupuestador de suscripciones SaaS: backend (Fastify + SQLite) y frontend (React + Vite).

scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
